techniques.what: Every frame is a pure function of the integer frame index.
techniques.how: renderFrame(f) only; seeded mulberry32; no wall clock/requestAnimationFrame/Math.random; headless Chrome+SwiftShader; PNG sequence -> H.264 yuv420p -an.
techniques.evidence: Two renders gave identical SHA-256 for 12/12 sampled frames; full MP4 hash stable across the refactor.

techniques.what: Scene beats are anchored to caption cue windows, never to hard-coded frame numbers.
techniques.how: buildTimeline(PKG) -> CUEF/cue(sid,i); visuals may lead words by SYNC_LEAD = round(0.3*fps); QC uses the same windows [cue start-0.3 s, cue end).
techniques.evidence: Caption retiming no longer breaks sync; checklist v2 + caption_sync_evidence.

techniques.what: One integer-frame master timeline; shots contiguous; cues inside shots; chapters are a view of the same timeline.
One style frame per caption cue from the SAME engine, with a contact sheet bound to the package digest and scene hashes, before the full render.
Whole-video animatic (every 3rd frame, 10 fps) and per-shot motion preview use the production scene, not a separate mock.
techniques.how: --prototype --animatic / --shot S00N (output outside the repo; behind the execution guard).

techniques.what: Heat/air/refrigerant flow reads as direction: comet trails with arrow-head sprites oriented along the on-screen path; colour encodes state.
techniques.how: Comets(createCometsClass) with curveOf/colorOf/arrows; red=warm, blue=cool; in-situ colour ramp for phase change.
techniques.evidence: Reviewer first render: 'particles float without flow direction' -> fixed from v2.

techniques.what: Mechanism props are articulated and cutaway-ready (pivoting louver, removable panel, visible coil/fins/blower) instead of boxes.
techniques.how: Reusable factories in engines/web/xdx_core/assets (character_bima.js, indoor_ac.js) with explicit parts returned for animation.

techniques.what: Keep the horizon level (camera.up = world up); move into an insert with a slow eased orbit (~0.9 s); cut on the action instead of whipping between targets.
techniques.how: look(...) with WORLD_UP; no lerp of the up vector; clean cut to the target when the IR fires, then slow push-in.
techniques.evidence: v4 showed 30-40 degree roll and a whip; fixed in v5; owner accepted pacing.

techniques.what: Render a taller virtual frustum and show its lower 80% (setViewOffset) so subjects sit above the caption band; verify the caption rect against the safe area.
techniques.how: camera.setViewOffset(W, H*1.25, 0, H*0.25, W, H); check_caption_safe_area on measured #capbox rects.

techniques.what: Locked character/style colours come from the signed character and style bibles; scenes never hard-code them; missing palette fails closed.
techniques.how: load_package_data injects character_palette; bindCharacterPalette validates #RRGGBB x4.

techniques.what: Frame 0 renders only after fonts/textures/models have settled; failures abort.
techniques.evidence: Scene loads under the barrier with identical output.

techniques.what: Re-render only shots whose input hash changed (storyboard entry, cues, semantic mappings, global files, assets used by that shot).
techniques.how: render_dependencies.json + shot_input_hashes + plan_selective_rerender. Limit: scene.js choreography is global until beats are split per shot (Phase 02B).
techniques.evidence: Cue edit -> only S003; Bima edit -> S001,S002; global edit -> all.

techniques.what: Fresh-context reviewer scores every shot on 7 dimensions + REF-002 comparison, with actual frame evidence per action and caption window; placeholders/debug overlays are critical.
techniques.how: visual_semantic_qc.build_visual_review_checklist/evaluate_visual_review; shot evidence hash-bound to the render.
techniques.evidence: 4 review rounds drove HARD_FAIL critical defects 21 -> 0.

techniques.what: Final delivery requires: hash/profile match, resolution/fps/frame count on the canonical timeline, no placeholder assets, shot evidence, safe-area report and an independent PASS review.
techniques.evidence: v5 correctly BLOCKED (no PASS review yet).

techniques.what: Accepted renders become pixel-hash regression benchmarks; refactors must keep them byte-identical.
techniques.evidence: 12/12 identical after moving Bima/AC/comets into modules.
